messages:
Noah (growth): Heads-up: weekly KPI deck shows a weird uplift in demo requests from blog traffic for 2026-03-15. Looks statistically significant but feels noisy.

Sana (analytics): I see it. Rolling 7-day z-score for demos from blog spiked to 3.1 on 2026-03-15. Link: https://redwood.app/dash/kpis?metric=demos&source=blog :eyes:

Priya (demand-gen): We ran a content boost on long-form that morning. Was small spend but targeted. Could be real. Also check referral domains tweet and hackernews.

BenchBot: Benchmark alert: demos_from_blog > expected_range for 2026-03-15 (z=3.1). Suggested checks: traffic_source_tags, landing_variant, cohort_overlap.

Sana (analytics): Quick breakdown by referrer:
- organic search: 42 demos
- referral (hackernews): 58 demos
- social (twitter): 12 demos
- unknown: 6 demos
Looks like an inbound referrer spike from hackernews.

Noah (growth): Hacker News post? Who posted? Was there a product share or a partner mention?

Priya (demand-gen): We had a community post from an external contributor at 09:03am linking to the blog (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=34567890). I flagged it in the comms calendar but didnt expect demo clickthroughs to convert that high.

Leo (ops): FYI the demo CTA had a small copy tweak on 2026-03-14 (A/B test). Variant B had a stronger microcopy: "See latency & cost benchmarks live". Could boost conversions. I can rollback if needed.

Sana (analytics): Adding conversion rate by landing variant: variantA 2.1% -> variantB 3.8% (on that day). So both referral spike + better CTA contributed.

Noah (growth): Good to know. For the KPI deck do we show this as a positive one-off or attribute to content strategy? Id like to call out which levers are repeatable.

Priya (demand-gen): Recommend: 1) annotate KPI deck that referral-driven spike from HN + variant B copy boosted CR; 2) run a small paid test targeting similar HN-like communities with variant B; 3) capture UTM 'hn-spotlight' for future.

Sana (analytics): Ill add a slide with the referral funnel & variant split + confidence intervals. Also will add a cohort analysis to show LTV/SQL rate for those demos next week.

BenchBot: Note: create benchmark note: "HN-driven demo uplift (2026-03-15)". Tag: content-opportunities.

Noah (growth): OK adding to Friday KPI review agenda: 5m recap + decision on paid test. If we do test, set small budget and measure cost-per-demo.

Leo (ops): Ill keep variant B live until we decide. If paid test goes ahead we should A/B at traffic segment level to avoid confounding.

Priya (demand-gen): Will draft test plan and share here by EOD.

Sana (analytics): Cool, will prepare the chart and add to deck.

Noah (growth): Thanks all. Putting a quick note in the KPI doc and tagging this thread. :white_check_mark:
